acceptance_criteria.description: Users must not be able to access any page without first logging in with valid credentials. Attempting to access protected pages while unauthenticated should redirect or deny access.
kane_steps: Open the browser and navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html without logging in
Observe that the user is not shown the inventory page
Verify the user is redirected to or remains on the login page

acceptance_criteria.description: After entering valid credentials (standard_user / secret_sauce) and submitting the login form, the user should be redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'
Click the Login button
Verify the user is redirected to the inventory page (URL contains /inventory.html)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Successful login redirects to inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page must display product tiles, each containing the product name, an image, and a price.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to the inventory page
Inspect each product tile on the page
Verify that every tile displays a product name, an image, and a price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name, image, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product name on the inventory page should open the corresponding product detail page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on the name of any product
Verify the product detail page is opened for that product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product name opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product image on the inventory page should open the corresponding product detail page.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on the image of any product
Verify the product detail page is opened for that product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product image opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page must display the product name, description, price, and an Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on any product to open its detail page
Verify the page displays the product name, description, price, and an 'Add to cart' button
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Product detail page shows all required fields

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can add a product to the cart from the inventory page by clicking the Add to cart button on a product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button on any product tile
Verify the product is added to the cart (e.g., cart badge count increases)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button works from inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking Add to cart on a product tile, the button label on that tile should change to 'Remove'.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Note the button label on a product tile reads 'Add to cart'
Click the 'Add to cart' button on that tile
Verify the button label now reads 'Remove'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Button changes to Remove after adding to cart

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart badge in the top navigation should update its count to reflect the number of items currently in the cart.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Observe the cart badge (it should show no count or zero)
Click 'Add to cart' on one product
Verify the cart badge displays '1'; add another product and verify the badge updates to '2'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart badge reflects current item count

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can remove a product from the cart directly from the inventory page by clicking the Remove button on that product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Verify the button label on that tile reads 'Remove'
Click the 'Remove' button on that tile
Verify the product is removed from the cart (cart badge count decreases)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button removes product from inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking the Remove button on a product tile, the button label should revert to 'Add to cart'.
kane_steps: Log in, add a product to the cart, and verify the button reads 'Remove'
Click the 'Remove' button on that product tile
Verify the button label reverts to 'Add to cart'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Button reverts to Add to cart after removal

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can navigate to the cart page at /cart.html via the cart icon in the top navigation.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the cart icon in the top navigation
Verify the browser navigates to a URL ending in /cart.html
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart icon navigates to cart page

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page must list all items that have been added to the cart, showing each item's name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in and add two or more products to the cart from the inventory page
Navigate to /cart.html
Verify all added products are listed on the cart page
Verify each listed item displays its name, quantity, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart page lists items with name, quantity, price

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page must display a sort dropdown in the top right corner allowing users to select a sort order.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate the sort dropdown in the top-right area of the page
Click the dropdown and verify the following options are present: 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', 'Price (high to low)'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown has all four sort options

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (low to high)' from the sort dropdown should display the cheapest product (Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99) as the first product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Price (low to high)'
Verify the first product tile displayed is 'Sauce Labs Onesie'
Verify its price is shown as $7.99
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price low to high sorts cheapest product first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (A to Z)' from the sort dropdown should display 'Sauce Labs Backpack' as the first product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Name (A to Z)'
Verify the first product tile displayed is 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name A to Z sorts Backpack first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (Z to A)' from the sort dropdown should reverse the alphabetical order of product tiles.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Note the product order with 'Name (A to Z)' selected
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Name (Z to A)'
Verify the product order is reversed compared to the A to Z sort
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name Z to A reverses alphabetical product order

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (high to low)' from the sort dropdown should display the most expensive product first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Price (high to low)'
Verify the first product tile displayed has the highest price among all products
Verify the products are listed in descending price order
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price high to low sorts most expensive product first
